name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Senior Growth Marketer | B2B SaaS Acquisition, CRO & Funnel Analytics for SMB Operators
summary: Growth marketer and operator who builds the acquisition engine end to end: paid search and social, SEO, landing pages, sign-up flows, CRM automation, and the dashboards that show what's working. Founder of Solenzo, where I market to and build for SMB service operators, the same buyer WanderOS sells to. Earlier at Wix, I ran growth consultations for SMBs launching on a website builder, contributing to a 25% conversion lift and 30% traffic growth across the e-commerce segment. I write the copy myself, and it sounds like a person.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own acquisition end to end: organic LinkedIn and SEO for my own business, and paid search, landing pages, and CRM-driven follow-up for clients.
Launched a free digital-footprint audit as a top-of-funnel offer, distributed through my own LinkedIn growth: 180+ businesses enrolled, 2 converted to paying clients.
Optimized a client's Google Ads account to cut spam and low-quality leads, then diagnosed on-site CRO as the remaining conversion bottleneck.

Run technical SEO audits, keyword gap analysis, schema implementation, and Google Business Profile optimization for SMB service operators, and install GTM and GA4 tracking in HTML/CSS on every site built.
Architected a 20+ workflow GoHighLevel system spanning lead capture, routing, qualification, booking, no-show recovery, and nurture, integrated with HubSpot, Zapier, Make, and n8n.
Build dashboards tracking lead volume, funnel conversion, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, using SQL on BigQuery/GA4 data.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led integrated growth strategy across inbound, paid media, and content for performance marketing clients.
Ran A/B-tested LinkedIn ad campaigns using an account-based approach, targeting small, highly researched audiences.
Advised clients on paid-media budget planning and allocation, and built reporting tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion.
Produced conversion-focused landing pages, multi-touch email sequences, and ad copy that improved lead generation and pipeline.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed a partner channel of 15-20 reseller agencies (deals ~$10K-$45K) selling local-listings and reputation software to SMBs, retaining all but one (~94%).
Sold and onboarded partners on Birdeye's listings-syndication solution, the backbone of the channel offer, using Whitespark research as sales-enablement material.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed paid media and creative performance at a performance marketing agency, translating results into optimization recommendations.
Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K, roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Led growth consultations for SMBs launching on Wix, aligning site architecture, inbound marketing, and SEO, contributing to a 30% traffic increase and 25% conversion improvement across the e-commerce segment.
Launched 25+ SMB sites per month at 120% of sales and 110% of implementation targets, including Google Business Profile setup alongside the build.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8) on a new vertical that went from proof of concept to profitable.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled, selling B2B SaaS to agencies and professional-services firms.
